text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You want to... simplify the campsite prep 
while we're training in the mountains?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"If we cut down on prep time, we can 
dedicate 
all those saved minutes toward our 
training."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...It's true that by the time we start a 
fire, cook rice, 
brew dokudami tea, forage for wild herbs, 
set traps, pitch the tent—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "the sun is already beginning to set."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. When dealing with nature, 
everything depends on circumstance and 
luck."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to cherish our time together. 
Especially when I have the honor of your 
company."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear... I see now. 
I'm touched by your thought, and I 
completely understand."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"But frankly, losing that time together 
would be... 
such a pity! Because I genuinely love it!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Rinsing rice, salting freshly caught fish 
with you 
in the peaceful quiet of nature... It's 
such a luxury. So—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'll tell you what! Let's find another 
way 
to carve out more training time!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"For instance, I could upgrade to a 
state-of-the-art tent 
that pops up in seconds!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...! Brilliant idea! 
In that case, I shall hone my hunting 
skills even further! 
That way, our meals will be prepared much 
faster!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, please do! —Fufu! We're becoming 
stronger and stronger in every conceivable 
way, aren't we!"
